_doc: What guardrail.bundle trusts, as data. `authorities`: the certificate authorities (CA certificate + its SHA-256) a signer's certificate may chain to; the lab root CA today, and an ITRI CA is one more entry. An authority vouches only for keys pinned under `signers` unless its entry says `accept_unpinned: true`. `signers`: the keys whose signatures are accepted, keyed by the signed_by identity - a key certified by an authority carries its certificate and `issuer`; a bare key with `retired_on` is accepted only for what was issued before that instant. Private keys never go in git.

lab-ca.note: certificate authority whose signer certificates guardrail.bundle accepts. Which CA is the authority of a delivery is the PI's and ITRI's to name; another CA is one more entry here.
lab-ca.subject: CN=VLA Guardrail Lab Root CA,O=VLA Guardrail Lab
